title.narrative: Tema-Aarhus cooperation on Water Management, Strategic Sector Corporation in Ghana

description.narrative: Water scarcity and poor water quality have a negative impact on growth and livelihood for poor families in the town of Tema, Ghana. The Mayor of Tema and his team have the ambition of improving water supply and sanitation, enforcing regulations concerning industrial waste, solving the problem of flooding, improving recreational areas, and improving collection of solid waste. Essential to human health and to environmental sustainability and economic prosperity. During the inception phase of this project, the Municipality of Aarhus and Aarhus Vand will identify areas of common interest in close dialogue with their Ghanaian counterpart (The Municipality of Tema and Ghana Water Company Ltd) leading to the formulation of a 3-year peer-to-peer collaboration aimed at improving water management in Ghana.
